concerns.text: FR-005 (Statistical Significance) and FR-006 (Sensitivity Analysis) require ANOVA, Bonferroni correction, and threshold sweeps. While T031/T032/T033/T035 exist, T020 (Reporter) and T021/T022 (Edge Cases) are marked incomplete. T020 is a hard dependency for T031 (ANOVA) and T037 (Full Benchmark). Without a completed T020 to generate `fidelity_report.json`, the statistical analysis tasks have no input data, leaving FR-005 and FR-006 unimplementable.

FR-007 (Latency Measurement) requires verifying frame-level inference time against a threshold. T028-config (defining 50ms threshold) and T028-logic (implementing pass/fail) are marked incomplete. T024 and T025 (Runner logic) depend on these tasks. Without the threshold definition and logic, the 'Real-Time Latency Verification' requirement cannot be executed or validated.

FR-010 and FR-011 mandate deriving motion labels from optical flow magnitude. T034-extended (implementing this logic) is in Phase 5. However, T007 (Data Loading) and T014 (Feasibility Filtering) depend on these labels existing or being available for filtering. This creates a circular dependency: data cannot be filtered (T014) without motion labels, but motion labels (T034-extended) are generated after filtering. T034-extended must be moved to Phase 2 to unblock T007/T014.

T020 (Reporter) explicitly depends on T021 (Edge case handling for ambiguous prompts) to generate `filtered_subset_manifest.json`. T021 is marked incomplete. Without T021, T020 cannot legally consume the manifest as required, breaking the chain for the fidelity benchmarking deliverable (FR-003/FR-009).
